lines: Have I become the person I always dreamed of being?
Seems I've come too far to ever turn back
On my own two feet, skipping steps, pushing further ahead
I should be able to keep running — ran away
Stitching up the wounds as they deepen

That one you hate — surely

Even if I propose it's worth zero

The me of yesterday is being killed off
Slowly drifting apart, growing weary
